title: Free — Image Compressor Website
description: A real-time tool with drag-and-drop images, Without Watermark, and friendly dashboard.

caseStudy.overview: SquooshLite is a high-speed browser-based image compression and optimization utility. It lets users drop heavy PNG/JPG files and compress them instantly with zero server latency, no loss in perceptual quality, and completely watermark-free.
highlights: Client-side instant compression with Canvas and Web Worker acceleration
Custom compression ratio slider with live before/after size comparisons
Bulk image conversion and one-click ZIP download
Fully responsive and mobile friendly interface

title: ShopNova — Modern Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce solution with payment integration, inventory management, and real-time order tracking.

caseStudy.overview: ShopNova is an enterprise-ready headless commerce solution built for high-throughput online stores. Features instant multi-faceted search, lightning fast cart interactions, automated inventory reconciliation, and webhook-driven order fulfillment.
highlights: Real-time inventory deduction & low-stock notification triggers
Customer dashboard with live delivery tracking map & receipt downloads
Sub-second page loads powered by server-side rendering & edge caching

title: DataPulse — Analytics Dashboard
description: Beautiful data visualization platform with interactive charts, custom reports, and multi-source data integration.

caseStudy.overview: DataPulse transforms complex telemetry and marketing data streams into actionable executive dashboards. It aggregates events from multiple cloud providers and databases, providing real-time KPI monitoring and automated weekly reports.
highlights: Dynamic drill-down interactive time series charts and choropleth maps
Custom SQL query builder with CSV/PDF reporting export
Role-based granular access control for teams and client stakeholders
WebSocket live metric stream with automated anomaly detection alerts
